about: What Joel has said stays as it is in the Bad Trips guide, and the cuts he meant: no card flags, fixes or puts these back (tools/humanization/keep_as_is.py, gate E340). Started 2026-11-04 from his answers to round 1 (review/r01/ANSWERS-R01-20261103-1859.json), his messages of 2026-11-03 (experiments/t01-answers/) and round 2 (review/r02/ANSWERS-R02-20261104-1026.json). His other edits, with the strings that prove they are in, are in OWNER-EDITS.json. The quotes are in the guide's characters after the standard swap (humanize/h01/swap.py): straight quote marks, spaced en dashes. | K12 ("adjunct remedy", round 5) released by his round-34 answer to ADJUNCT, "b" (review/r34/ANSWERS-R34-20261111-2357.json, 2026-11-11 23:57:59 UTC): the sentence became "While a seizure continues, the rescue medicine comes first, and I'd still consider DMSO alongside it, although that's experimental." (Human, Medium, 83f4caef).
